back: An adjective describing an activity that gives you a lot of positive experiences (e.g., voluntary work) [1].
Describes a pursuit or partnership that produces good results [1].
An activity that makes a lot of money, such as selling one's own crafts [1].
Something that makes you healthy in body and/or mind, like yoga or meditation [1].
An activity that takes a long time to do, such as being a committee member [1].
An informal term for someone who is a big fan of anything cultural (theatre, art galleries, etc.) [1].
An informal term for a physically very inactive person who spends hours watching TV [1].
A person who never keeps doing one activity for long; they start a pastime and soon get bored [1].
An informal term for a person who is addicted to shopping [1].
An expression meaning to take a great interest in or be very involved in an activity [1].
An informal way to say you stopped liking or lost interest in something [1].
An informal expression meaning to be addicted to something, like motor racing [1].
An informal phrasal verb meaning to 'do' something, especially at weekends [1].
A collocation describing a schedule with a lot of commitments or activities [1].
An expression used to describe someone who isolates themselves from the world to focus on an activity [1].
